title: Request: Short extension for pilot — credits vs extra days
text:
Request: Short extension for pilot — credits vs extra days

['From: Sophie Miller <sophie.miller@bluehaven.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot extension request: extra days vs usage credits

Hi Aditya / Rachel,

Quick ask from the BlueHaven POC team — we hit an internal blocker in our data prep and need a short runway extension to finish the final integration tests. Two options procurement will accept:

1) Add 10 calendar days to the current timebox (no price change), or
2) Keep the timebox as-is and add 200k token credits to our account as a one-time grant (procurement prefers this since it maps to a line item).

Our engineers prefer option 2 because it avoids changing milestone dates, but I wanted to surface both since legal/finance sometimes push for a formal extension instead. Attached is our latest usage report and a short note from our Eng lead about the blocker (pilot_usage_report.pdf).

Can you confirm what you can offer? If needed we can jump on a quick 20–30 minute call tomorrow.

Thanks,
Sophie Miller
Head of ML, BlueHaven AI
Sophie.Miller@bluehaven.ai

Attachments: pilot_usage_report.pdf
', "From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Miller <sophie.miller@bluehaven.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request: extra days vs usage credits

Hi Sophie — thanks for the note and the usage report. Sorry to hear about the prep blocker. We have two practical levers here and I'll summarize trade-offs so procurement/legal can pick:

- Option A: +10 calendar days to the pilot window (no additional credits). Fastest to approve from our side — minimal paperwork (simple addendum).
- Option B: Grant token credits (we typically handle 1xxk–200k grants as a commercial concession). This maps cleanly to a line item on a PO.

A hybrid is also possible: reduce credits requested to 120–150k and add a small ops support package (1–2 days of Engineering support) to help unblock integration — cheaper for us and operationally valuable to you.

I'll loop David (legal/finance touch) to confirm any contractual steps. Rachel, can you confirm approximate credit sizing we can commit to without exec review and whether we can include 2 engineering days as a one-time support SKU?

If Sophie is free, happy to do a quick call tomorrow 10–11 PT to finalize.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

", "From: Sophie Miller <sophie.miller@bluehaven.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-19T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request: extra days vs usage credits

Thanks Aditya — 10–11 PT tomorrow works for a quick sync. Procurement actually prefers a credits-based approach because their PO system requires unitized lines; they also want the finance impact visible in the quarter.

If you're willing to consider the hybrid (credits + 1–2 eng days), that should be acceptable to legal and procurement. We have a PO template they want filled (attached PO_template_BlueHaven.docx) — their target is a single line for credits plus an optional engineering services line.

On the call we can confirm exact numbers but our team would prefer not to shift the timebox dates if we can avoid it.

—Sophie
Sophie Miller
Head of ML, BlueHaven AI

Attachments: PO_template_BlueHaven.docx
", "From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Miller <sophie.miller@bluehaven.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request: extra days vs usage credits

Hi Sophie — following our call this morning, appreciate the context. We've put together a formal, narrow offer that should align with procurement's PO needs while keeping the project schedule intact: 

Offer summary (final):
- 120,000 token credits applied as a one-time commercial grant (line item for PO).
- 2 engineering support days (Redwood Eng) to help unblock the integration — limited to onboarding/troubleshooting for the pilot environment.
- Contingency: if post-support the integration still needs more time, we will add a soft 7 calendar day window as a fallback (only activated if credits are accepted).

I've attached the proposed addendum (proposed_addendum_v2.pdf) with the credits line and a short SOW for the two engineering days. If that looks good, we can route a DocuSign addendum and you can attach the PO to it. For your convenience here is the DocuSign link we will use: https://app.docusign.com/redsandbox/sign/ADDENDUM-DH10842 (placeholder).

Next steps:
1) Sophie — confirm acceptance of 120k credits + 2 eng days.
2) We'll send the DocuSign addendum and Rachel will copy the final PO.
3) Once signed, credits are issued within 24 hours and the eng days are scheduled.

Happy to discuss further on email or quick call if procurement has questions.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com

Attachments: proposed_addendum_v2.pdf
"]
